concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-payto-api-only]] — 2026-09-15-captured PayTo API-only guide for AU/AUD discovery, one-time/subscription mandates, stored-method charges and webhook finality; source flags form-versus-required-field and token-reference tensions.
warnings: Page says no shopper information need be collected in merchant payment form, but /payments tables require shopperAccountIdentifier and shopper first/last name; source does not resolve the data path.
Token guidance names recurringDetailReference, RECURRING_CONTRACT pspReference and recurring.token.created data.storedPaymentMethodId; do not substitute without verifying.
Subscription/subsequent examples omit commas after shopperReference and response snippets are curl-shaped; identifier regex table is not a validated copy-ready schema.
